shared_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one clear real-world photograph for a Spanish-speaking beginner's English review. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material grain and plausible lighting, NOT an illustration, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, internal padding, fake blur bands, watermarks, answer captions, letters or logos. Show exactly the requested subject and quantities, fully visible. A first-time learner must recognize the meaning at phone size. Fresh scenes for this review only; no imitation of previous course photos. Each scene is a separate review station, not one continuous cast or event.

assets.prompt: An inviting public park photographed from a low eye-level diagonal angle along a curving gravel path toward a clearly visible public playground with swings and slide. Mature jacaranda trees, grass, dappled afternoon light, distant adults walking. The public recreation space is unmistakable, not a private yard or school. No institutional building, street traffic or signs. Natural broad scene.

Eye-level candid photograph outside the open entrance of a neighborhood primary school in morning light. Several school-age children with large clearly visible backpacks walk into a supervised courtyard with classroom doors and windows; an adult teacher welcomes them at the gate. Real Latin American school context without flags or words. Complete children and backpacks, natural anatomy, no slide/playground or park scene. The entrance and school routine establish the place without a SCHOOL sign.

A real short pedestrian bridge made of honey-colored timber, crossing a narrow flowing river in a leafy town. Three-quarter viewpoint from the riverbank makes the complete span, railings and water flowing underneath clearly visible. No buses, no road traffic, no signs. Warm early-morning light, detailed weathered wood and water. Different from a stone arch bridge.

One full-size yellow city bus seen from a front three-quarter viewpoint at a quiet paved terminal. Tall windshield, repeated passenger windows and folding passenger doors are clear. All wheels and the full vehicle fit with generous margins. No second vehicle, people blocking its shape, writing, route numbers, logos or signs. Real slightly worn vehicle paint, soft overcast daylight, not a tiny model.

One open hardback book alone on a textured cream linen-covered side table, high three-quarter close-up. Its complete two facing pages, thick page block, spine and plain burgundy cover are clearly identifiable, no phone or pen. Soft window light rakes across real paper. Pages may have tiny unreadable natural lines of print, but no readable words, illustrations, labels or large letters. Complete book with margins, cozy realistic home background.

One unmistakable modern smartphone with a light beige protective case and black reflective glass screen, lying diagonally on a pale stone cafe table. Close high-angle photograph with its entire shape, lens opening, side buttons and softly rounded corners visible. No other objects, no writing on screen, no book-like hinged cover. Natural daylight, slight fingerprints and real reflections. Phone large and centered.

First-person view looking down and across a small bright entry room. Learner's LEFT hand holds the handle of a complete small rust-orange fabric handbag close to the camera; the bag is clearly visible in the lower middle. A SECOND identical rust-orange handbag rests on a low wooden shelf one meter beyond, upper middle, smaller but still at least one fifth the image width. Learner's RIGHT hand points with its index finger at the NEAR bag held by the left hand, clearly short of the bag and not hiding it. Two plausible attached forearms enter from bottom, five fingers per hand, complete bags and handles. No other bags. Cream walls and pale tile floor; honest near/far depth, both sharp. Near bag within central 60 percent. The gesture means THIS, not THAT.

Exactly TWO matching blue wooden chairs on pale tiles, BOTH COMPLETELY inside the photograph, including every leg and seat; leave at least 8 percent visible floor below every chair foot. Both whole chairs fit within the same compact patch of floor; background wall need not show. Learner's LEFT hand grips the NEAR backrest while the RIGHT index finger indicates the FAR chair from below, fingertip stopping clearly short of its silhouette. Two anatomically plausible forearms enter from lower corners, never cover seats or legs. Use a high downward camera to show both complete chairs and honest modest depth. Both chairs and pointing direction immediately legible at phone size. Real blue painted wood, daylight, no extra chairs, tables, text, labels or inset panels. Natural front three-quarter photograph, full vehicle with all wheels visible, real red paint and realistic scale. No other vehicle, bike, person, logo, legible numberplate or text.
